digest.component_or_area: pytest test fixture teardown / snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: Snapshot producers in modules other than test_snapshot.py leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots because cleanup was owned only by a module-local fixture.

Production snapshots are intentionally published with 0444/0555 permissions, causing ordinary shutil.rmtree to fail with PermissionError on residual cache entries during pytest basetemp teardown on macOS.

The fix centralizes snapshot cache teardown in tests/conftest.py as an autouse fixture that searches below each test-owned tmp_path for exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and calls snapshot._rmtree_writable to restore permissions before removal.
Snapshot permissions remain read-only during test execution and cleanup is scoped only to .rebar/run_snapshots roots; unrelated temp content below tmp_path is untouched.
